profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer / Salesforce Platform Architect at H-E-B
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer / Salesforce Platform Architect
profile.summary:
Senior Staff Software Engineer and Salesforce Platform Architect with a proven track record of designing and scaling enterprise systems in high-growth, high-demand environments. Recognized as a technical authority in Salesforce architecture, leading system design, integration strategy, and platform evolution across large-scale, multi-org ecosystems.

Architect for one of the largest Salesforce implementations in the industry, supporting 200K+ users, 100K+ daily logins, and hundreds of millions of weekly transactions. Deep expertise in building scalable, resilient systems and defining integration patterns across complex enterprise landscapes.

Progressive career growth from hands-on developer to enterprise architect, consistently driving higher levels of technical ownership and influence. Known for translating complex business challenges into well-architected solutions, mentoring engineers, and establishing best practices that improve system quality, scalability, and delivery efficiency.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / Salesforce Platform Architect
positions.description:
Principal-level individual contributor driving enterprise architecture and platform strategy for one of the largest Salesforce environments in the industry. Lead system design, integration patterns, and platform evolution across a multi-org ecosystem serving 200K+ users (employees, suppliers, vendors).
- Architect and deliver enterprise-scale solutions across retail, pharmacy, e-commerce, and corporate domains.
- Support a high-scale platform with ~103K daily users, 150M weekly transactions, and 1.7M daily API callouts across two integrated production orgs.
- Technical Lead during COVID-19, delivering critical systems enabling remote operations and business continuity.

Key Projects:
- Corporate Assist Store (CAS): Workforce solution enabling corporate employees to fill store shifts during staffing shortages.
- COVID Vaccine Manager: Scalable platform for vaccine scheduling (external portal) and pharmacy operations, designed for rapid regulatory change.
- E-commerce Call Center: Architecture for Salesforce-based customer service supporting curbside and delivery.
Retail Media OMS: End-to-end system for campaign lifecycle management across sales, creative, and activation teams.

Impact:
- Architectural authority across ~70 engineers spanning 7 teams; influence design without direct management.
- Define best practices for system design, integrations, and release management at scale.
- Mentor engineers and guide leadership on technology strategy and platform investments.

positions.title: Salesforce Architect
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Owned architecture and delivery of Salesforce platform solutions, overseeing all services and ensuring alignment with business and customer needs.
- Defined technical strategy and architectural vision, designing scalable, high-performing solutions across systems, subsystems, and integrations.
- Led solution design reviews, driving improvements in performance, scalability, and maintainability across new and existing implementations.
- Partnered with customers and stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into clear architectural solutions, establishing solution intent, data models, and technical documentation.
- Delivered end-to-end Salesforce implementations, from discovery and design through deployment and post-launch optimization.
- Applied SAFe Lean-Agile principles to lead large-scale solution delivery, improving team alignment, delivery predictability, and system quality.

positions.title: Salesforce Architect
positions.description:
- Led architecture and delivery of Salesforce platform solutions, driving system design, process optimization, and enterprise integrations.
- Defined scalable solutions aligned to both short-term business needs and long-term technology strategy.
- Partnered with business and technical leaders to translate requirements into integrated system designs across internal and third-party platforms.
- Served as Lead Technical Architect in collaboration with Salesforce Professional Services for Field Service Lightning (FSL), contributing domain expertise that influenced product design and industry best practices.
- Acted as Technical Architect and Product Owner for one of the first production implementations of FSL, consolidating CRM and field service operations into a unified platform.
- Contributed to Miner Corp receiving the Salesforce Customer Trailblazer for Service Award (Dreamforce 2016). https://www.salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2016/05/05/miner-selects-salesforce-lightning-to-enable-faster-and-smarter-customer-service-from-the-phone-to-the-field-for-its-workforce-nationwide/

positions.title: Application Developer III
positions.description:
- Designed and delivered custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, and front-end technologies to support business-critical workflows.
- Partnered with business analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical implementations.
- Led development of high-quality, testable, and maintainable solutions across the Force.com platform.
- Evaluated and integrated new CRM technologies and third-party solutions, improving system capabilities and cost efficiency.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for working with Business Analysts, Developers and Stakeholders to implement, test, and deploy solutions for our User base, using APEX and Visual Force, as well as leveraging HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, and other technologies.

·     Design, develop, test, document, and deploy high quality business solutions on the Saleforce.com platform in Salesforce.

·     Develop on-target Salesforce solutions, leveraging Force.com APEX Class, Triggers, Visual Force Pages, Components, and Validation Rules.

.     Evaluate new CRM technologies/add-ons and develop plans for their implementation into Salesforce.com and recommend cost effective technology solutions for business challenges.

positions.title: Freelance Web Designer/Developer
positions.description: Design and develop professional websites for businesses and individuals.

positions.title: CRM Application Administrator
positions.description:
- Managed and customized Salesforce CRM platform to meet evolving business requirements.
- Designed and implemented data models, application logic, and user interfaces to support enterprise workflows.
- Ensured system integrity, reliability, and performance through ongoing enhancements and governance.
- Delivered technical recommendations to improve system capabilities and user experience.

honors.title: Customer Trailblazer for Service
honors.description: Served as Lead Technical Architect and product owner for the first ever implementation of the Field Service Lightning platform in a Salesforce.com production environment resulting in a consolidated CRM and field service management system. Miner was recognized with the Customer Trailblazer for Service Award at Dreamforce 2016 for this endeavor.
